status: Submitted iPhone-only version 1.0.0 (3) to Apple App Review. Apple confirmed Waiting for Review on November 5, 2026 at 11:39 PM America/Chicago. Automatic release after approval; free in the United States.
name: Skill Sprout: Reading Tools
subtitle: Tools for growing readers
promotionalText: Measure reading fluency, track student progress, and simplify everyday grading with tools for parents, teachers, and tutors.
description:
Skill Sprout puts practical reading and classroom tools in one place.

FLUENCY TIMER
Time oral reading, mark and undo errors, review results, and calculate words correct per minute and reading accuracy.

RUNNING RECORD
Calculate reading accuracy and self-correction ratios.

QUICK GRADER
Turn total questions and incorrect answers into an assignment percentage.

STUDENTS AND HISTORY
Create student profiles, save passage titles and word counts, and review previous reading attempts.

LOCAL STORAGE
No account is required to use the app. Student profiles and reading results are stored on your device. No advertising or third-party analytics.
reviewNotes: No login is required. On the home screen, select Fluency Timer, enter a passage name and total word count, then choose Start Reading. On the timer screen, tap Start, use Error and Undo while reading, then Stop Reading. Review the values, Calculate, and continue to Save Result. Students and passages can be added from the Students tab and More > Manage Passages. Running Record and Quick Grader are available on the home screen.
remaining: Wait for Apple App Review and respond to any review feedback. Automatic public release follows approval.
contentRights: No third-party content; confirmed by owner.
